retrievalProfile.description: A retro 1950s pop aesthetic featuring marquee-style display typography, a glowing jukebox, and a soft-focus portrait against a vibrant cyan background.

recipe.visualDefinition: A composite image featuring a smiling woman in mid-century attire positioned next to a glowing, illuminated jukebox. The scene is bathed in a soft cyan light with a black header bar containing technical stereo labeling. Large marquee-style text dominates the top, while a yellow script sits at the bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: The woman and jukebox are blended through a soft-focus, ethereal glow.
The black header bar provides a structural anchor for technical metadata.
The marquee text acts as a heavy visual weight at the top, balanced by the script at the bottom.
coreInvariants: Marquee bulb effect inside block lettering
Black header bar with yellow and white technical text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The female subject is right-aligned, mid-shot; the jukebox is left-aligned and slightly recessed in scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large marquee-style name at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the marquee name, move down to the subject's face, then follow the jukebox's glow to the script at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample cyan space around the subjects creates a dreamlike, airy quality.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Yellow and Warm Orange (Jukebox lights and script text)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value and moderate saturation in the background; high contrast in the typography.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy slab or block sans-serif and casual brush script
letterConstructionRules: Main title uses thick block letters with an internal grid of white circles (bulbs).
Secondary text uses a fluid, connected brush script with a slight upward slant.
Header text uses a wide, geometric sans-serif.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Bulb patterns are centered within the stroke of the block letters.
Script letters have a heavy black drop shadow to pop against the background.

treatment.fill: gradient brown-to-orange with white bulb pattern

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of rigid, industrial marquee block letters with fluid, organic brush script.
graphicDevices: Black header bar with white horizontal rules

avoid: Serif fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the marquee bulb aesthetic perfectly.
Matches the mid-century casual brush script style.
Appropriate for the technical header text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a 1950s-style composite image with a glowing vintage jukebox on the left and a smiling woman in a light blue sweater on the right. Use a vibrant cyan background with a soft white glow behind the subjects. Include a solid black bar at the very top with thin white lines.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large block letters with a marquee bulb pattern for the main title at the top. Add a yellow brush script with a black outline at the bottom. Place technical 'STEREO' text in yellow sans-serif in the top black bar.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a visible bulb pattern?
Is the background a vibrant cyan gradient?
Is there a black header bar with technical text?
Is the script text yellow with a black outline?

mustRedesign: Any modern sans-serif fonts in the main title
postGenerationChecks: Verify the marquee text has a drop shadow for depth.
Ensure the woman's hair and clothing reflect the 1950s era.
Check that the jukebox light spill affects the surrounding cyan space.
Confirm the header bar text is horizontally aligned and clean.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [1950s portrait] + [Illuminated Jukebox] + [Cyan Gradient] + [Marquee Bulb Typography] + [Black Technical Header] to recreate this retro pop aesthetic.
